name: my-page-links
description: A Firefox extension to manage and organize your page links.

scripts.copy-assets: powershell -Command "Copy-Item src/manifest.json dist/; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist/popup | Out-Null; Copy-Item src/popup/popup.html,src/popup/popup.css dist/popup/; if (Test-Path src/icons) { Copy-Item -Recurse -Force src/icons dist/ }"
scripts.dev: pnpm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist
scripts.package: pnpm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts
